schema_note: Three schemas in one contract. An entry with its own 'schema' key is checked against that schema; an entry without one uses the manifest-level 'schema' (readiness). validate.py honours the per-entry key from set 1.8; tests/conformance must do the same (qa-engineer change request, CHANGELOG set 1.8).
note: All values synthetic. The PHI guards are: readiness-free-text-reason, readiness-exception-text-field, log-field-mrn, log-field-payload, log-value-multiline, log-message-id-not-uuid, log-nested-object, log-error-exception-text, metrics-label-message-id, metrics-label-partition-key. Proposed as OBSERVABILITY_PHI_GUARDS (10) for tests/conformance.
expectation_note: Pairs written 2026-10-05 by the architect WITHOUT a run: predictions until validate.py --emit-expectations (or --check-expectations) measures them. Set 1.8 W3-17 amendment adds one valid and two invalid readiness examples, also predictions.

valid.note: Async MLLP receiver, all three receiver checks pass
Sync-reply receiver: reply_consumer is mandatory and passes
Startup: the raw metadata round trip has not completed, listener not yet bound (README 2.4 rule W1)
topics/v0 3.3.1 rule 2: no reply partition held, so not ready
Set 1.8 (W3-17): the broker refuses the reply consumer's principal. unauthorized, not no_partition; the log line carries REPLY_CONSUMER_UNAUTHORIZED
Invariant 3: a channels-topic outage after the first spec is degraded, never not_ready (README 2.3 ruling R3)
No spec ever loaded: not ready, nothing accepted (the W3-18 refusal case)
Control-plane API /readyz; a Kafka publisher outage is degraded, reads still served
Canonical message_id, class-name error, registered code, trace context
A librdkafka error NAME as error_code, never broker text
Deprecated tb_msg_id alias, accepted in v0 with the uuid shape
The registry itself. validate.py also cross-checks it (labels defined, per_metric values listed, bucket sets named)

invalid.violates: status ready requires every gating check ok
status not_ready must name a failing check
a failing check carries a reason code
reason is a closed code list; free text is where broker strings, principals and hosts arrive (invariant 6)
every receiver reports spec, component and raw_producer
sync_reply true requires the reply_consumer check (topics/v0 3.3.1 rule 2)
no free-text field exists; exception text never reaches the probe body (invariant 6)
a passing check carries no reason, so a stale reason cannot linger

set 1.8: the spec check has no unauthorized reason. Before the first spec it reports no_spec and the log line carries CHANNELS_UNAUTHORIZED; after it, a channels-topic fault is degraded only (README 2.3 R3)
set 1.8: each receiver check carries only its own reasons (README 2.3 table); no_partition belongs to reply_consumer
field name mrn denotes a direct identifier (invariant 6)
field name payload carries content (invariant 6)
a value with CR or LF forges a second log line
message_id is an engine uuid; an identifier in its place is PHI
values are scalars; a nested object is how headers get dumped
error is an exception class name, never str(exc), which quotes the offending value
ts, level, event and component are required
label names are a closed list; a message id label is unbounded and linkable
the record key is usually a patient identifier and is never a label (envelope/v0 section 4)
a counter name ends in _total
a histogram names its bucket set, so every emitter buckets alike
